 Introduction 
 Jesse 
This is Jesse Pujji and today we are breaking down ViacomCBS. This episode has a different format. You'll hear from both an investor and from company management. Chris Marangi from Gabelli Asset Management starts us off with a history of ViacomCBS. He goes deep into the dynamics of content creation, curation, and distribution, hitting home the value of IP. Then he helps break down how ViacomCBS is transitioning from a shrinking linear business to a growing streaming business. Next, I sit down with the CFO of ViacomCBS, Naveen Chopra. He shares his views on the business today, how he thinks about capital allocation and how streaming will evolve for ViacomCBS. Please enjoy this business breakdown.

Chris, welcome to Business Breakdowns.
